findings.name: UFortSignInWidget::StartSignIn
findings.evidence: The wrapper increments the script frame code pointer when present and tail-jumps to the body. The body checks the control at widget+0x470 and requires nonempty text at widget+0x450. It copies the latter into widget+0x440 and invokes virtual slot +0x48 of the interface pointer at widget+0x410, passing text from widget+0x450 and widget+0x458; widget+0x418 controls pointer validity. No frontend travel is present in this body.

findings.name: UFortSignInWidget::HandleTextCommitted
findings.evidence: On commit method 1, checks control at widget+0x458 and validator 0x144dc8370; successful validation calls StartSignIn body.

findings.name: UOnlineAccountCommon::TriggerLoginComplete
findings.evidence: Log literal identifies function. Sets account+0x368 to 2 and calls 0x140693420 on account+0x3c0 with result 2 and a value returned by 0x1407c2c80. The account delegate is also accessed by UFortLoginInteractions::HandleLoginRequestComplete. This does not establish that invoking this function alone creates a valid authenticated account.

findings.name: UOnlineAccountCommon::LoginStep_Completed
findings.evidence: Log literal identifies function; after completion work it calls account virtual slot +0x408. The implementation at that slot is not established here.

findings.name: UOnlineAccountCommon::LoginStep_OnLoginComplete
findings.evidence: On successful callback and further account checks, calls account virtual slots +0x308 and +0x3f8 and 0x1410c3c30 to continue the login process. Requires online identity state and is not established as an entry point for local account selection.

findings.name: UFortLoginInteractions::HandleLoginRequestComplete
findings.evidence: Log literal identifies function. It accesses the online account held at interactions+0x418 and account delegate +0x3c0. In the ordinary result-2 branch it does not call the error handling path; further success handling was not established by this function alone.

findings.name: Direct caller of TriggerLoginComplete
findings.evidence: At 0x1422367b2 calls TriggerLoginComplete after calls to 0x140684de0 on another object+0x360 and 0x14221de80(account), then continues additional work. Caller identity and prerequisites are not established.

findings.name: Widget construction and interface storage
findings.evidence: GetPrivateStaticClass identifies FortSignInWidget, object size 0x480, and constructor helper 0x1452db9b0. Runtime helper jumps to constructor 0x144da86a0, which installs vtable 0x146d77500, zeros widget+0x410 and the dword at +0x418. Destructor at vtable slot 0 calls 0x140692d60 on widget+0x410. Constructor does not acquire the interface. The interface setter, dynamic type, and virtual slot +0x48 target remain unidentified.

findings.name: ELoginResult::Success
findings.evidence: The reflected /Script/Account ELoginResult identifies Success as value 2, consistent with TriggerLoginComplete passing 2 to the account delegate.

unresolved: Identity of the widget interface virtual slot +0x48, safe local-account completion entry, and downstream success subscribers remain unproven. Do not substitute a direct state flip or frontend travel on the basis of these findings.
